name: proto-blocks/cadco-header
title: Cadco Header
description: Site header: logo, the site navigation menu, search and a call-to-action button, with an optional mega menu (design A) and mini-mega menu (design B) attached to chosen menu items.

navMenu.label: Navigation menu
navMenu.help: Which navigation menu to display. Menus are edited in the Site Editor.

megaAttachTo.label: Design A — mega menu on
megaAttachTo.help: The top-level menu item that opens the full-width mega menu.

miniAttachTo.label: Design B — mini menu on
miniAttachTo.help: The top-level menu item that opens the compact card menu.
